history.change: A signal must still carry its edge on the quote showing when it fires, not only on the three-minute average.

Signals stop at minute 34, not 38: the model knows nothing of fouling and clock play. An average needs three readings of its own covering two and a half minutes, and the recorder keeps a reading every 30 seconds. Team totals are dropped: their lines were implied from the total and spread, and their price was an estimate.
